_comment: Encodes intentional differences between template/docs/conf.py.jinja and the upstream canonical/sphinx-stack conf.py. Consumed by scripts/analyze_conf_diff.py to avoid false positives when upstream changes a key we deliberately diverge on. 'rule' governs how upstream changes to the key are handled.

_rules.ignore_upstream_changes: This key is a template addition or intentional replacement. Report the upstream change for awareness but never auto-apply it.
_rules.merge_upstream_changes_preserve_custom: This key is a list/dict that combines upstream entries with our own. Apply upstream additions/removals but never touch 'custom_entries'.
_rules.keep_active: Upstream keeps this commented out; we keep it active (often templated). Apply upstream value changes but keep it uncommented.

version.description: Added by this repo; drives ogp_site_url and html_baseurl construction.
version.rationale: Upstream may not define a top-level 'version' variable. Removing or changing it upstream must not affect our template.

sitemap_filename.description: Explicitly set to 'doc-sitemap.xml' for consistency across downstream repos.
sitemap_filename.rationale: We standardize the sitemap filename regardless of upstream defaults.

html_js_files.description: Upstream list plus our template-specific overwrite_links.js.
html_js_files.rationale: overwrite_links.js is a template addition for link rewriting; preserve it while accepting upstream additions.

slug.description: Commented out upstream; active here inside a {% if rtd_slug %} conditional.
slug.rationale: Required for Read the Docs-hosted downstream projects.

html_theme_options.description: Commented out upstream; active here inside a {% if source_edit_link %} conditional.
html_theme_options.rationale: Downstream projects need the edit-on-GitHub button.

html_static_path.rationale: The template ships a _static/ directory that must be registered.

templates_path.rationale: The template ships a _templates/ directory that must be registered.

ogp_site_url.description: Upstream uses a hardcoded URL; we use a {% if rtd_slug %} conditional falling back to READTHEDOCS_CANONICAL_URL.
ogp_site_url.rationale: The environment-variable-based lookup is the intended multi-project pattern.

html_baseurl.description: Upstream uses a hardcoded URL; we use a {% if rtd_slug %} conditional falling back to READTHEDOCS_CANONICAL_URL.
html_baseurl.rationale: Same as ogp_site_url — environment-variable-based lookup is intentional.
